_comment: AICodeArena universal problem template. Replace placeholder values before activating a new problem. This template uses a browser HTML assignment because it is the simplest current starting point.
_comment_id: Use lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. Example: contact-form-layout
title: Replace This Problem Title
description: Replace this with a short assignment summary.
_comment_sourcePlatform: Examples in the current repo use values such as custom and zyBooks.
_comment_assignmentType: Free-form metadata label. Choose something descriptive such as html-form, dom-manipulation, css-layout, or node-pug-template.
_comment_evaluatorType: For new authors, choose one of the current active evaluator types: browser_qunit_html, browser_qunit_css, browser_qunit_mocked_api, browser_qunit_javascript, or node_jest_pug_jsdom.

instructions._comment: studentPrompt is what the model sees. Do not place hidden tests, point values, or reference solution content here.
instructions.studentPrompt: Replace this with the exact student-facing assignment instructions. End with a clear output contract such as: Return the complete index.html file.

files._comment: Editable file: the model is allowed to return this file and it should usually be required in the submission.
files.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <title>Replace This Title</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
</head>
<body>
  <!-- TODO: Replace with starter content for the assignment -->
</body>
</html>

files._comment: Read-only file: preserved in the evaluator workspace and shown to the model only when includeInPrompt is true and promptPolicy.showReadOnlyFiles is true.
files.notes: Optional notes field. Use this for author-facing clarification only.

referenceSolution._comment: Optional but strongly recommended. Each reference solution file path must match an editable file path exactly.

files.content: Example Reference Solution

submissionRules._comment: The current active system expects complete-file submissions. editablePaths must match every editable file path exactly.
validation: Reject explanatory text outside the HTML.
Perform an HTML syntax check where practical.
submissionRules.notes: Keep output strict. Invalid formatting should fail validation rather than being auto-cleaned.

runtime._comment: Runtime values describe how the evaluator should execute the assignment.

promptPolicy._comment: The loader currently requires showTests=false, showPointValues=false, and showEvaluatorType=false.

tests._comment: Each hidden test needs a meaningful name because it becomes the frontend label shown in per-test results.
tests.name: Page title

scoring._comment: maximumPoints must equal the exact sum of tests[].points.

metadata._comment: Author-facing metadata. Replace these values with real tags, difficulty, and notes.
knownIssues: Replace this placeholder list with any evaluator-specific caveats for the problem.
notes: Replace placeholder metadata before marking the problem ready.
